name: core-animals
description: Animals living in an area: a herd, flock or school (species: dog, cat, pug, duck, goose, chicken, sheep, goat, cow, horse, pig, fox, deer, rabbit, bird, crow, seagull, koi, fish; or def: any kit creature). Each one wanders, grazes or swims (on water areas) around its own spot. Area shape. Client-side, no server cost.

def.doc: a kit creature def instead of the species (e.g. "core/dog@1" or your own)

behavior.doc: water areas always swim

name: core-dog
description: A friendly medium dog (rounded low-poly, ~600 tris) that trots about its yard: diagonal-pair walk, head nod, wagging tail. Recolour with params fur/muzzle/ear. Behaviours: wander (default), follow, sleep.

behavior.doc: what it does (client-side, deterministic): wander/graze within radius of where it was placed, swim in water, perch, sleep, fly loops, follow a ref, idle

radius.doc: how far from home it roams (m)

follow.doc: entity id or path to follow (behavior follow)
